# Wolf companion art

Artwork: **[LPC] Wolf Animation**, originally published by William.Thompsonj.

- Graphic artist: **Stephen “Redshrike” Challener**.
- Contributor and commissioner: **William.Thompsonj**.
- Original: https://opengameart.org/content/lpc-wolf-animation
- License selected for this use: **Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)**, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
- Source file: `wolfsheet1.png`, preserved unmodified as `wolf.png` (640 × 384), mirrored from https://github.com/TheMoneyRaider/Time-to-Love/blob/main/art/wolfsheet1.png; artwork credited to the original creators above.
- Usage: cosmetic, animated companion of the hero in the equipment screen and battlefield. No combat stats or extra attacks.

The original pack includes six alternate colors and animations for walking, running, biting, howling and dying. This initial integration uses the first color variation and the walking frames only. No original artwork is redrawn.
